verdict.rationale: Cua Driver is documented to let an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux through MCP or a CLI, with its own cursor working in the background in the user's apps rather than one walled app. Spaces add full agent desktops where the agent can, for example, build and test a Windows app. One hands-on report shows the agent typing into the OS, but in the wrong place, followed by connection failures on an early version; that points to reliability problems, not absence of the capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of click, type and keyboard-shortcut actions, and independent corroboration of successful cross-app control on current versions.
